name: FUN_ADM_RULE_CONDITIONS_
description: This table contains the conditions for attribute derivation rules.

columns.name: CONDITION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the attribute derivation rule condition.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the attribute derivation rule to which the condition is assigned.

columns.name: USER_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Indicates the order in which the rows are displayed.

columns.name: BRACKET_LEFT_CODE
columns.description: Short name associated with the left bracket used in a condition.

columns.name: BRACKET_RIGHT_CODE
columns.description: Short name associated with the right bracket used in a condition.

columns.name: VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Value type code, source or constant.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_TABLE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the attribute target.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the attribute that is used in the transaction.

columns.name: VALUE_ATTR_TARGET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the attribute target value.

columns.name: VALUE_ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name of the source value.

columns.name: VALUE_CONSTANT
columns.description: Constant value when the value type is Constant.

columns.name: LINE_OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: Short name associated with the line operator used in a condition.

columns.name: LOGICAL_OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: Short name associated with the logical operator used in a condition.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.
